name: Saki Achiga Hen episode of Side-A Portable
original_name: 咲-Saki- 阿知賀編 episode of side-A Portable
source:
The Achiga Girls' Academy in Nara once defeated regional mahjong powerhouse Bansei High School. It advanced into the national team semifinals but lost to the eventual champion, and the mahjong club was later disbanded.

Six years later, elementary school student Takakamo Shizuno befriends transfer student Haramura Nodoka. The two eventually enter Achiga Girls', but Nodoka transfers out of the school in the second year.

When Shizuno sees Nodoka on television the following year as the national middle school individual mahjong champion, she decides to revive Achiga's mahjong club.

[From [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=8701]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
奈良市的阿知贺女子学园曾击败过地区麻将强队万星高中。晋级国家队半决赛，但输给了最终的冠军，麻将社随后解散。

六年后，小学生高贺茂静野与转校生原村野花成了朋友。两人最终进入阿智贺女子学校，但诺多卡在第二年转出了学校。

第二年，当静野在电视上看到诺多卡成为全国中学个人麻将冠军时，她决定重振阿智贺的麻将俱乐部。
